messages:
kevin: quick thread to align on sidecar provenance + fallback policy. ran into ambiguity in staging - sidecar forwarded requests without provenance and billing got messy. anyone seen this? :grimacing:
tara: saw that yesterday. sidecar defaults to 'best-effort' provenance today which is too vague. we need an explicit signed provenance token for cross-zone hops.
lee: agree. suggest format: `X-RW-Provenance: v=1;zone=private;adapter=sidecar;orig_tenant=TENANT;sig=BASE64` where sig is an HMAC or RSA over the rest.
mina: please ensure signature uses tenant-specific key material. for private/airgap we'll use a local KMS and never export keys. hosted can have ephemeral signing keys from CP.
kevin: good point. policy also needs to declare allowed fallbacks. propose three modes: `deny`, `log-only`, `allow` (with billing attribution required). default for private tenants = deny. default for hosted = allow.
tara: we should add a `local-grace` flag: when CP unreachable, sidecar can serve from local-cache or queued retries, but only if tenant enabled `local-grace`. that avoids silent cross-zone failover.
lee: implement policy as a signed blob: CP publishes policy blobs per-tenant (`policy.v1.json`), sidecars fetch and cache. blob contains `fallback_mode`, `allowed_dest_zones`, `grace_modes`, `provenance_expectation` and `billing_rules`. sidecar verifies blob signature before applying.
mina: plus1. blob signing uses CP key; sidecar trusts a CP root cert pinned at deploy time in private installs. For hosted mode, sidecars can validate via standard CA chains.
kevin: what about billing headers? when fallback happens, destination must receive `X-RW-Billing: src_zone=private;orig_tenant=TENANT;billing_bucket=dedicated` and the header must be signed or provenance must attest to it.
tara: also need to prevent header spoofing inside dedicated clusters where tenants share infra. adapters should refuse unsigned billing headers unless they validate provenance signature.
lee: operationally we need probes: 1) policy blob rotation test, 2) provenance header test (valid/invalid), 3) fallback enforcement test (try to force sidecar to fallback and ensure policy applied), 4) billing attribution canary that hits hosted with fallback and verifies billing record.
mina: add telemetry: emit `fallback_event` with fields (tenant, from_zone, to_zone, reason, policy_version, probe_id). keep event minimal and send to customer-owned sink where possible. for private setups, telemetry may be queued to local storage and exported when CP reachable.
kevin: action items: tara -> draft blob schema + examples; lee -> header signing spec + sample verification code; mina -> KMS/key distribution notes for private; ops-bot -> open ticket for probes/canary pipeline. I'll collate into a short RFC.
ops-bot: [ticket] probes/canary pipeline created: CAN-4521.
tara: one more: feature-flag rollout. we must gate default change behind ff so we can flip defaults per org.
kevin: agreed. RFC will include rollout plan and rollback steps. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
